summary: The clipping formulas, breakpoint enumeration, endpoint cases, and one-variable minimization correctly give G_lambda = 1/8 on the full interval. Consequently M_lambda(1/4) exceeds 11/48, monotonicity yields R_1(lambda) <= 1/4, and the accepted fixed-direction endpoint values imply the stated strictly negative Farkas-weighted bound. The common-point argument for the closed complements is valid for 0 < lambda <= 1 and at lambda = 0.
